notes.content:
1. Civilization Expedition Conquest, After the original Civilization Expansion Season ends, a new Civilization Treasure Season will be added.
The world defenders in the Treasure Season will be significantly stronger than those in the Civilization Expansion Season, including all famous cities, docks, treasures, and unoccupied cities. Famous cities in neutral areas can be occupied by players at any stage.

notes.title: Big update! ——The real-time online translation function is officially launched!
notes.content:
Dear players:

Since its official launch in December 2023, Conquest of Empires 2 has been widely loved by players from all over the world. However, the huge game content and rich language environment have become obstacles to communication among players.

In order to bring a better gaming experience to all city owners and make language communication no longer a barrier, this update will bring in-game real-time translation functionality!

The new version will include the following:
1. Add automatic translation function
Other language content on the interfaces such as chat, email, alliance announcements, and personal announcements can be translated into the client language version you are using through the in-game real-time translation function. For example: If you are an English player, no matter whether other users use Russian, French, Portuguese, Chinese or other languages in the game, you can use the one-click translation function to translate into the client version language you are using.

For example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699014/ee2c814c10b3ef9b8f26dd98cee7a934970f4f07.png[/img]

2. Adventurer optimization:
Civilization Expedition will add an adventurer profession soon. Based on user feedback, we noticed that the game upgrade experience for adventurers in the current version is very difficult, and we will increase the rewards adventurers receive for the alliance after researching singular points, so the new version will There are the following changes:
1. Hero experience and auxiliary professional experience will also be increased when using adventurer skills such as treasure hunting, addressing, secret exploration, and fog detection.
2. After researching and completing the singularity point research, there will be a certain probability that the boss treasure will be directly refreshed at the singularity point location.

3. Other function adjustments:
——In order to meet the common needs of players in different time zones, the double event on Sunday will be open all day on Sunday after the new version is launched!
——In order to meet the communication needs of players in the game, in the new version, a player can join the chat groups of multiple officials at the same time.
——In order to meet the upgrade needs of users, the number of defenders in the training camp has also been increased accordingly.
——Allied plots can also be used for practice!
——Unoccupied non-empty areas can also be searched
——For players who may not have as much online time, we have adjusted the function of the Alliance Fortress. In the new version, collective expeditions can be used in Level 1 Alliance Fortresses, and large treasures can be "touched for rewards" by collective expeditions. ! )!
Adjustments in the gameplay of Civilization Expedition 1:
——5-star hero fragments have been added to the national store. 5-star hero fragments can be purchased in the national store later.
——The opening time of the military camp battle has been changed from the current Monday, Wednesday, and Friday to Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday, and a preview of the rewards after the military camp is occupied has been added.

4. Other client optimizations:
——All boss treasure pictures are optimized
——All treasure windows display the accurate treasure type (for example: large treasures with limited access times per day, giant treasures, etc.)
——The text for sharing coordinates, battle report sharing, and alliance building names will be automatically converted to the language of the client version you are using.
——Optimize the full attribute prompt when attacking the scroll
——Optimize the stamina consumption prompt in the ruins battlefield
——Optimize the effect of plot selection
——Modification of the battlefield appearance of Fire Soldiers, Giant Hammer Soldiers, and Fire Arrow Soldiers

5. Bug fixes:
——Fixed some level experience display errors in hero training
——Fixed the problem that the position of Yanyue Formation and other formations exceeded the boundary
——Fixed the problem that Niezi and others could not be searched on the mini map interface.
——Fixed the problem of not displaying the number of days when researching singular points
——Fixed the display error of rogue bandits’ drops
——Fixed the display error of merit rewards in ruins battlefield
——Fixed some picture errors of trading houses
——Fixed some translation errors

notes.title: Conquest of Empires 2-Trade Age version update
notes.content:
Dear city lords

The new Trade Era version is now online, come and experience it! Here are the game updates:

1. Big upgrade of trading gameplay:
50 trading houses have added trading house bosses, who can receive new trade tasks. Completing tasks can obtain generous rewards and unlock the exchange function of local trading houses.
Trade house bosses have new exchange functions. Players can exchange in all trade houses 3 times a day to obtain various rare props and currencies.
There is a new chance of finding collection fragments in the trade treasure chest.
Note: Each product has a 3-7 day exchange cooling time (the same product shares the cooling time in different trading houses). It is recommended that players go to different trading houses every day to find exchangeable products.
Note: Some mission conditions, such as gold treasures, shipwreck treasures, windmills, war colleges, merchant camps, etc., are randomly refreshed according to the original rules and require a certain amount of luck and patience to complete.
Note: Some mission conditions, such as Miracle Search, have a chance of success and there is only one chance per day. It requires a certain amount of luck and patience to complete.
Note: At the trade port in the inner city, if you find a trading house with a green name when you open it, it means that this trading house has become popular. Go to the popular trading house to trade. You can see that some trade target points are colored. Complete These colorful trades can yield multiple rewards.


2. The tavern adds the function of inviting heroes:
If you have a 5-star or above hero who has left without reaching 100 friendship points, a button to invite the hero will appear on the main interface of the tavern.
Select the hero you want to invite. After consuming one world recruitment refresh time, you can re-invite this hero to the hotel and you can re-recruit him.
The invitation function has a cool-down time. Please wait until you have enough currency before inviting.

3. Expedition function adds batch expedition:
On the troop confirmation interface of the expedition interface, a new option [Do not close the troop selection interface] has been added below. Once selected, multiple troops can be continuously selected for an expedition target point, which can reduce the need to repeatedly click on the target.
On the troop confirmation interface of the expedition interface, click on the 5 hero portraits to open the troop adjustment interface.

4. Optimization of the hero illustrated book combination function:
Now all heroes have a picture book combination effect, which can be viewed and operated in the [Hero Biography] on the hero interface.
After collecting a combination, you need to manually activate the attributes to increase the effect.
Each combination has upgradable functions. After collecting more heroes or the heroes evolve, they can be upgraded to more advanced attributes to increase the effect.

5. Automatic auxiliary monthly card optimization:
The automatic auxiliary monthly card has a new automatic expedition function, which can be used on unowned famous cities and giant treasures. The effect is the same as the original automatic sweep.
In the automatic expedition and automatic sweep state, click on the expedition troops, and the [Cancel Auto] function is added to the small troop interface on the right side of the scene.
If you purchase the automatic auxiliary monthly card, you will receive an additional 980 diamonds.
Purchase the quick upgrade and get an additional 980 diamonds

6. Task optimization:
The entry level of the Sahara Desert Ruins Battlefield is adjusted to level 31-50
The entry level of the Amazon Rainforest Ruins Battlefield is adjusted to level 51-60
After entering the ruins battlefield, the missions in the ruins battlefield will be displayed on the main interface. After completion, you can directly click to receive the reward.

7. The content dropped by attacking famous cities and BOSS has been increased:
5 new city appearances have been added to the treasure chests of various continents for attacking famous cities.
Among the drops from attacking the BOSS, the appearance of the lake monster ship, the appearance of the Snowman Kings march, the appearance of the Savage Kings march, and the appearance of the Camel Knights march have been added.

8. Heroes and formation optimization:
The skill of the Egyptian Pharaoh is adjusted to the command skill: prohibiting a random enemy infantry unit from restoring its strength and reducing its armor by 35 points.
Skill adjustment after the first evolution of the Shanshe Battalion to 4 stars: Increase the attack speed of own soldiers by 18%
Optimized the positions of hidden troops in the Flying Geese Formation, Yanyue Formation, and Surprise Attack Formation

9. Alliance function adjustments:
Officials with [Manage Alliance Buildings] permissions can click on the cities of other alliance members to enable war exemption for them.
When a country is upgraded, emails explaining alliance gain changes for relevant officials and members will be added.

10. Other adjustments:
The total number of hero fragments given by the growth mission is adjusted to 200 for each hero.
When attacking high-level special resources, you no longer need to manually give up low-level ones first. Low-level ones will be automatically given up when occupying high poles.
A new background has been added to the formation challenge interface, and you can now view the formation status of all levels to be challenged.
Increased hero experience gained from formation challenges and ranking challenges
